decision.title: One build with everything (owner, 2026-10-20)
decision.summary: Every shipped build, the sxml command, the native libraries and the one WebAssembly module, has every language and optional feature, size budgets rise to fit, and XSLT and XPath get fn:load-xquery-module.

body.p: , after , , , . The owner, on 4.25 leaving fn:load-xquery-module out of XSLT to keep XQuery out of XSLT builds: "We don't need to separate builds like this: with sxml you get everything (adjust size budgets as necessary), because halfway solutions already exist."

item.p: Every shipped build has everything: the sxml command, the native libraries and the JavaScript package contain every language (XPath, XQuery, XSLT, XSD) and every optional feature. There is one WebAssembly module for JavaScript; hosts do not pick a smaller one.

Size: budgets are set for that one module and rise as features land (). The core sxml.wasm budget of / no longer limits what a feature may add; a large size growth is still reported (), as a fact, not a reason to leave something out.

What stays: the optional-feature view () and the per-language part lists () are internal structure and public API that stay stable; no shipped build uses them to leave parts out. Feature data still comes from the host through the resolver.
XSLT gets fn:load-xquery-module (XSLT 4.0 and F&O 4.0), and any other function a language left out only for size is added.
Done by size-3 (commits 4f5a8bf, a62058e, and the records):

fn:load-xquery-module's row is the library part xquery_module (src/function_library_xquery_module.c, ) serving every language: XSLT and XPath too (F&O 4.0, 18.2 leaves the host language to decide; the QT4 sets are XP31+ XQ31+). Its body stays in src/xquery_load_module.c; XQuery's own table keeps fn:put only. No header change. QT4 XP40 fn-load-xquery-module 0 to 56 passed (4 failed, 81 not run), fn-function-lookup 657 to 661; XQ40 sets unchanged; XT40 load-xquery-module wrong errors 4 to 1 (001: F&O 4.0's FOQM0002 for a missing module, the suite wants XQST0059 or FOQM0006).

JavaScript: one module, sxml.wasm, 7,701,002 / 1,713,241 bytes (was 2,135,535 / 744,728; sxml-full.wasm was 7,700,970 / 1,713,185) under the full module's budget 8,000,000 / 2,800,000, not raised; the baseline is the one module's map. The export ./sxml-full.wasm names dist/sxml.wasm; Sxml.features and createProcessor({ features }) are unchanged; load() refuses a module without the XQuery, XSLT and XSD exports. sxml_host_core_features.c is gone.

Already everything: the sxml command (one processor creation, sxml_query_run_start, with sxml_all_optional_features() and EXPath File under --allow-file-access), the native sxml_host (sxml_host_full_features.c) that the Kotlin and Swift bindings link, and the QT4, XSLT and XSD drivers. In the C library itself a host still names the features it wants ('s view stays).

Other size-only exclusions searched (DECISIONS, QUEUE, src/): none left. EXPath File stays out of sxml_all_optional_features() and the JavaScript module for access, not size (). XPath's Full Text parser stays a grammar of its own (): structure, every build has it. fn:put stays XQuery's (XQUF 3.0).
